Gentle Dental Concord Hospital, 246 Pleasant St, Concord, NH 03301 will be merging with Gentle Dental Concord, 410 South Main Street, Concord, NH 03301. The Concord Hospital location will be closed.

Located on South Main Street, on the border of Bow NH, Gentle Dental Concord offers all phases of dental care from general services to more specialized care. Recently renovated, our practice features a stunning 2 story atrium entrance and a modern, yet comfortable atmosphere. In 2017, we expanded our practice to the second floor of our building to better serve patients with evening and Saturday appointments.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Gentle Dental Concord dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services. By staying on top of the latest advances in dental care with continuing education and training patients can feel confident in the high quality care they receive. Building long-standing, trusting relationships with patients is a key part of overall care.

Whether you use your healthcare credit card to cover your deductible, or to pay for treatments and procedures not covered by insurance, CareCredit helps make them possible today.

Get instant access to significant savings on all dental services plus free exams and x-rays. Choose individual, two-individual, or family coverage and enjoy peace of mind knowing you can maintain your oral health. The Essential Dental Plan is not insurance.
